items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: I used the last straws, you know, and Roy Liberto's band and, uh, uh, Hector Fontana's band. And, uh, we went over and we were supposed to portray a, uh, brass band

ctx.x: Just how it started and everything. Well. Who do you saw?

Well, they, they had a, they had a festival in Cuba, which is very like Mardi Gras here, only it wasn't on Mardi Gras. It was on May the 1st, which is, and around that time, I believe the thing's been going on a month, mainly on weekends. Very like Mardi Gras here, only a little wilder. More frightening. Uh, like here, you're, if you're not with Zulu, all you got is a lot of drunk people wandering up and down with drinks in their hands. There, they were all seen to be dancing in the street, passed on, packed on…
Uh, do they have a lot of steel bands there? Not. Or are they mostly further?
